_original_lore: The Burningsoul Demon is a Inferno Demonlord
Miniboss that very rarely spawns after killing a
Blaze during Inferno Demonlord Tier IV Quests.
name: 焚魂恶魔 (小首领)

source: The Burningsoul Demon is a Inferno Demonlord
Miniboss that very rarely spawns after killing a
Blaze during Inferno Demonlord Tier IV Quests.
loreParagraphs.translation: 焚魂恶魔是一种炼狱恶魔领主小首领,在炼狱恶魔领主 IV 阶任务中击杀烈焰人有极低概率生成.
